name: Fitchburg FMC II 2023

venue.name: Fitchburg Community Center
venue.details: Swan Creek Room, enter through the Senior Center entrance on the north side of the building.

information: This competition only holds the Fewest Moves event. If you are looking for a competition with more regular events, please check out [5x5 on Madison Ice 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/5x5onMadisonIce2023). You may bring a maximum of 1 guest to this competition due to size constraints. Competitors 18 years and up are recommended to attend alone. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2RUIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--88db22939a52174b1c1219cca04859925d5bdeea/image.png)
